forbidden.name: core-single-dependency
forbidden.comment: Gate G6 + ADR-02: runtime-core ships exactly one runtime dependency (semver). This single rule covers every host library (react, vite, sql.js, indexeddb, bun) at once.

forbidden.name: core-no-node-builtins
forbidden.comment: Gate G6: the core is environment-neutral; AbortController/EventTarget and friends are host globals, never node: imports.

forbidden.name: internal-not-importable-across-packages
forbidden.comment: ADR-01 + note 06: packages/runtime-core/src/internal is unreachable outside runtime-core; the exports map enforces this at packaging time, this rule enforces it at source time.

forbidden.name: adapters-depend-on-core-only
forbidden.comment: Note 05: adapters depend on core; core never depends on an adapter, and adapters never import each other.

forbidden.name: examples-use-core-only
forbidden.comment: Note 07 Phase 2: the two example hosts share only the core and public test kit, not application code.
